What is the sum of the interior angles of a nonagon?
What is each interior angle of a regular hexagon?
How many diagonals does a pentagon have?

An angle is 128°. What is its supplement?
One of a pair of vertically opposite angles is 68°. What is the other angle?

Using π = 22/7, what is the area of a circle with radius 7 cm?

A semicircular garden has radius 7 m. Using π = 22/7, what is the perimeter including its straight diameter?

A circle has radius 10 cm. What is the length of a 90° arc?

A circle has radius 3 cm. What is its area?

A closed cylinder has radius 3 cm and height 4 cm. What is its total surface area?

A sphere has radius 3 cm. What is its volume?
A sphere has radius 4 cm. What is its surface area?

What is the slope of a horizontal line?
What is the y-intercept of the line y = 3x − 4?
What is the area of the triangle with vertices (0, 0), (6, 0), and (0, 4)?

A square has a diagonal of 10 cm. What is its area?
